narrative.synopsis: Arachne’s skill is real, but her boast turns craft into a direct challenge to Athena. The weaving contest exposes divine shame and mortal defiance, ending in transformation.
narrative.openingSituation: Arachne’s reputation as a weaver has become a refusal to honor Athena.
narrative.centralConflict: The contest is about artistry and authority: whether mortal truth-telling can survive divine anger.
narrative.resolution: Athena destroys the boundary between punishment and craft by changing Arachne’s body.
narrative.outcome: Arachne continues weaving as a spider, her art preserved and diminished at once.
